name: Biographical Claim Pre-Check
description: Pre-write hook on biographical claims in T4 outreach drafts. Greps draft for tenure/role/report-count/scale/date-range/role-org patterns; verifies each against canonical_sources via numeric+capitalized-token co-occurrence; BLOCK on any unanchored claim.

changelog.summary: first ship — pre-write hook on biographical claims in T4 outreach drafts
changes: HOW.py greps draft for tenure/role/report-count/scale/date-range/role-org patterns; verifies each against canonical_sources via numeric+capitalized-token co-occurrence; BLOCK on any unanchored claim
AUDIT.sh consumes enforcement log; tallies shipped/blocked/bypassed; flags T4 INPUT/ drafts with no matching HOW record
WATCH.sh 3 micro-experiments (false-positive rate, pattern coverage, pattern effectiveness); cadence ladder weekly->per-T4-artifact
Default canonical: $CAREER_OS_HOME/brain/identity/experience-history.md (set CAREER_OS_HOME env var to your career OS home dir)

deps.purpose: default canonical source for user's biographical claims

origin: Two T4 hallucination near-misses on 2026-04-26: Matt Kleinman email (4 unanchored claims) + Amanesh Goyal Roblox Safety AI fwd-packet (3 unanchored claims). Both shipped past the EMERGENT SYSTEM IMMUNITY invariant prose. The fix is the pre-write hook in code.

variance_reduction.mechanism: executable claim-pattern regex + canonical-source anchor verification
variance_reduction.prior_state: prose rule 'verify before ship'; interpreted as optional self-review by every LLM family

litmus: Run HOW.py before shipping any T4 outreach draft with biographical claims. PASS = every claim anchors in canonical. BLOCK = at least one unanchored claim — recheck source before sending.
